title: Intradiscal pressure under 400 N axial compressive preload (lumbar FSUs)

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute intradiscal needle pressure under 400 N compressive preload before moments; mean only (SD not given here; reported in Part II, Berkson 1979)

source.authors: Schultz AB, Warwick DN, Berkson MH, Nachemson AL
source.sample: 42 lumbar motion segments from 23 cadavers (16 segments from 10 F, 26 from 13 M); posterior elements removed in the first 18; human cadaver lumbar FSUs L1-L2 to L4-L5 (levels pooled; 3 segments from a Marfan donor, 1 herniated disc), degeneration grade 0-4

protocol.summary: Single FSUs, vertebrae embedded in epoxy and screwed into fixtures, disc mid-plane horizontal; inferior fixture clamped (rotatable to 0/90/180/270 deg); superior vertebra unconstrained. 400 N compressive preload (vertical strings + pneumatic cylinder) maintained during moments. Moments applied by weights via strings and pulleys on 20 cm arms in >= 3 increments, static, non-repetitive; readings 15 s after each increment (15-25 s to record). Rotations seldom allowed > 8 deg. Motions of the superior vertebral body centre from 6 dial gauges (0.01 mm). IDP by Nachemson needle (membrane-tipped) in the disc, 5 kPa resolution, re-zeroed between sequences. Posterior elements (facets bilaterally, ligamenta flava, inter- and supraspinous ligaments) then removed in the first 18 segments and tests repeated.
how_to_simulate: Model a lumbar FSU, inferior vertebra fixed
Apply 400 N axial compression through the disc centre
protocol.notes: Values are means over all segments tested at each load level (n per cell not given; some segments did not reach 10.6 Nm because rotations were limited to ~8 deg); '(a)' cells = 3 specimens. Levels L1-L2 to L4-L5 pooled. Resection: one step only - removal of all posterior-element connections (bilateral facet joints, ligamenta flava, inter- and supraspinous ligaments) in 18 of 42 segments; values are absolute, not % intact, and intact means are over all 42 segments (not paired).

data.note: Table 3 caption ("mean initial pressure was 262 kPa"); text cites Part II
